races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
UNFLINCHING made his 2m hurdle debut in what turned out to be a very strong maiden at Limerick last Christmas and is taken to come good on return stepped up to a trip which is sure to suit. Henry de Bromhead's Midtown Manhattan should have more to offer now stepping back up in trip and is second choice ahead of the more-established Young Doran.

  1. UNFLINCHING (FR)
  2. MIDTOWN MANHATTAN (IRE)
  3. YOUNG DORAN (IRE)

races.name: Connolly's RED MILLS Irish EBF Auction & Median Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
ROKANAKO sets the standard among those with experience and may get off the mark under Michael Kenneally. Hurdling debutant Don't Hold Back is potentially interesting in a weak race, while S T Hamo faces a more realistic assignment than on his hurdling bow last week.

  1. ROKANAKO (IRE)
  2. DON'T HOLD BACK (IRE)
  3. S T HAMO (IRE)

races.name: Clonmel Oil Service Station Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CEANNDANA is back on a handy mark over hurdles and may well capitalise. Zoffman and Hopeful Hero look the main dangers in a race that's likely to be tactical.

  1. CEANNDANA (IRE)
  2. ZOFFMAN (IRE)
  3. HOPEFUL HERO (IRE)

races.name: T.A. Morris Memorial Irish EBF Mares Chase (Listed)
races.verdict:
It would a major shock if DINOBLUE couldn't comfortably account for her rivals here. A Snow White Park might be able to follow her home.

  1. DINOBLUE (FR)
  2. A SNOW WHITE PARK (IRE)
  3. JOLIE JEWEL (FR)

races.name: Clonmel Oil Chase (Grade 2)
races.verdict:
IL ETAIT TEMPS is now unbeaten in his last 7 completed starts, a wide-margin winner of this race last year before going on to success at both Cheltenham and Punchestown in the spring, and he is hard to oppose on his return. Stablemate Kappa Jy Pyke can be the one to give the selection most to think about, Willie Mullins having won the last 4 renewals of this Grade 2.

  1. IL ETAIT TEMPS (FR)
  2. KAPPA JY PYKE (FR)
  3. BLAZE THE WAY (IRE)

races.name: Prior Park Service Station Clonmel Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict:
Sent off favourite returning over fences, ONEFORTHEDITCH was undone by an awkward landing 2 out when finishing mid-field at Galway a month ago, so she is well worth another chance off her significantly lower chase mark. She gets the vote ahead of Courtbrack Boy who made an encouraging chasing debut, while Stily could also be in the mix.

  1. ONEFORTHEDITCH (IRE)
  2. COURTBRACK BOY (IRE)
  3. STILY (FR)

races.name: racingtv.com/freetrial Flat Race
races.verdict:
Gordon Elliott has taken this prize in 2 of the past 3 years and his Poet's Word gelding GREENBRIER, placed on his sole run in a point, is taken to add to the tally with last year's winning rider Harry Swan in the saddle again. Red Seagull rates the pick of those with experience and is next on the list ahead of River Cartwright and Distraction.

  1. GREENBRIER (IRE)
  2. RED SEAGULL (IRE)
  3. RIVER CARTWRIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Download The Star Sports App Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The vote goes to CREST OF STARS who was a dual hurdles winner last season and can get off to a successful start in this sphere for his in-form handler. Bond Broker has chasing experience on his side and could prove the danger.

  1. CREST OF STARS (IRE)
  2. BOND BROKER (IRE)
  3. SOOMAROY (FR)

races.name: Bet On-Course With Star Sports Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KLIC BOUM made a promising start in this sphere after an absence when taking second late on at Newton Abbot and with this return to a longer distance also a plus he looks the way to go. Sweet Caryline should also take a step forward from an encouraging chasing debut fourth at Worcester and can give the selection most to do.

  1. KLIC BOUM (FR)
  2. SWEET CARYLINE
  3. BREEZETHROUGHLIFE (IRE)

races.name: Star Sports We Believe In Bookmaking EBF Mares' 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks a good opportunity for Irish point winner JENNY FRANCE to get off the mark under Rules. Lady Litigator looks most likely to follow her home.

  1. JENNY FRANCE (IRE)
  2. LADY LITIGATOR (IRE)
  3. POSH CHICK

races.name: Call Star Sports On 08000 521 321 Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FERRET JEETER proved a prolific winner last season and this C&D scorer looks to have been found an excellent opportunity to go in at the first time of asking back chasing. Melton Mossy wasn't foot perfect when successful at Stratford but could still prove the chief threat to Anthony Honeyball's likeable sort.

  1. FERRET JEETER
  2. MELTON MOSSY (IRE)
  3. ENJOY D'ALLEN (FR)

races.name: starsports.bet Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This should go the way of a hurdling debutant given the pair with experience have achieved little. CENTRAL COMMAND may just edge Barbury Boy and Pantile's Gift if running up to his Flat form.

  1. CENTRAL COMMAND (IRE)
  2. BARBURY BOY
  3. PANTILE'S GIFT

races.name: Star Sports Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BEL OMBRE looked a natural when a wide-margin winner on his chasing debut at Worcester and is fancied to make light of a 10 lb rise here. The returning Kdeux Saint Fray has some solid form to his name and appeals as the one to chase him home.

  1. BEL OMBRE (IRE)
  2. KDEUX SAINT FRAY (FR)
  3. RIP WHEELER (IRE)

races.name: starsportsbet.co.uk Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CREST OF ARMS is by far the least exposed of the quintet, and he's fancied to make a winning handicap debut for an in-form yard. Course regular Ez Tiger narrowly edges out Stroll On By as the pick for the forecast, in a race where it's hard to rule out any.

  1. CREST OF ARMS
  2. EZ TIGER (IRE)
  3. STROLL ON BY (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BRACE FOR LANDING was better than the result when mid-field in the Imperial Cup when last seen and can capitalise on a significantly easier task this time. Spreadsheet Guru can pose the biggest threat if ready making his yard debut after an absence, whilst point winner Ludois merits a second look.

  1. BRACE FOR LANDING (IRE)
  2. SPREADSHEET GURU (IRE)
  3. LUDOIS (FR)

races.name: Racing At The Heart Of Our Community Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
FRESHERS WEEK makes plenty of appeal on the pick of last season's form. He's worth another chance with Brian Hughes taking over and his yard in superb heart. Aire Spray and Letterston Lady head the dangers in an interesting race for the grade.

  1. FRESHERS WEEK (IRE)
  2. AIRE SPRAY (IRE)
  3. LETTERSTON LADY

races.name: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
THORNEYLANDS was well suited by the step up in trip making his handicap debut when joining the leader on the line at Kelso in May and he is taken to score again with further improvement to come. The main danger could be Presentandcorrect.

  1. THORNEYLANDS (IRE)
  2. PRESENTANDCORRECT (IRE)
  3. BOLD LIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Get Raceday Ready Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Successful in a Southwell maiden hurdle back in March, NICE ONE ERIC disappointed starting out in handicaps at Ayr a month later. However, still lightly raced he looks to have been found a very winnable race now chasing for the first time and could be the answer before market clues. Looking Splendid boasts a really good record fresh and may emerge as the main danger.

  1. NICE ONE ERIC
  2. LOOKING SPLENDID
  3. HALPHA SOLEIL (FR)

races.name: Get Raceday Ready Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Equine Products National Hunt Trainers League Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
EMPTY NEST remains on a handy mark and can go one place better than he did over C&D last week. Treaty Boy would make serious appeal after his recent Kelso win, though a fall earlier in the week at Sedgefield is far from ideal. Tom Creen looks best of the rest.

  1. EMPTY NEST (IRE)
  2. TREATY BOY (IRE)
  3. TOM CREEN (IRE)

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap Chase
attheraces.com/marketmovers 'Junior' NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
THAT GUY represents powerful connections and can make a winning debut. Bran Galad should know more than on his debut this time and might be able to turn the tables with penalised Albatross The Ace.

  1. THAT GUY (FR)
  2. BRAN GALAD
  3. ALBATROSS THE ACE

races.name: OLBG Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SPIRITS BAY often goes well fresh and looks a potential class angle in a wide-open renewal. He narrowly shades the vote over race-fit and unexposed Zarakerjack, while Faivoir would be interesting if supported from a slipping mark.

  1. SPIRITS BAY
  2. ZARAKERJACK (FR)
  3. FAIVOIR (FR)

races.name: CSP Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PRESLEY shaped with plenty of promise in a couple of bumpers last season, building on his debut effort despite his exuberance when second at Warwick in March. He rates a very bright prospect now hurdling for his top stable and shades preference over Merlin Allen, who was a very good third in an Aintree Grade 2 bumper himself in the spring. Moments Away and useful Flat performer Insanity are also respected.

  1. PRESLEY (IRE)
  2. MERLIN ALLEN (FR)
  3. MOMENTS AWAY (IRE)

races.name: Grahame Church Memorial Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
NAN'S CHOICE's Grade 2 bumper success at Aintree on her first outing for Dan Skelton marks her down as one who could go a long way over hurdles. Princess Day and Connells Cross shaped with promise in the same Chepstow novice on hurdle debut last month and are likely to go well. Nicky Henderson point recruit Royal Response is one to monitor closely in the betting.

  1. NAN'S CHOICE (IRE)
  2. PRINCESS DAY (IRE)
  3. CONNELLS CROSS (IRE)

races.name: Pertemps Network Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Lots with chances. MOON CHIME was in the process of running really well (still in front) when falling at the last in the Silver Trophy at Chepstow on his return and this winning stayer on the Flat is worth siding with on his first try over this 3m trip. Recent Ffos Las scorer Kilwaughter heads the list of dangers, although a good case can also be made for the likes of Bill Baxter, Splendid Fellow and Western Monkey in this fascinating handicap. The Jukebox Kid completes the shortlist.

  1. MOON CHIME
  2. KILWAUGHTER (IRE)
  3. BILL BAXTER (IRE)

races.name: Check Out The BetVictor Betbuilder Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PERCY DE COURCY looked a good prospect when scoring easily on his sole points run so is taken to make a winning start in this sphere now starting out for the all-conquering Skelton team. Spare The Voice was also successful on his only outing in points so could emerge as the main danger on his debut for Nick Scholfield ahead of Grand Teton and Coolnav who rate the pick of those with experience.

  1. PERCY DE COURCY
  2. SPARE THE VOICE (IRE)
  3. GRAND TETON (IRE)

races.name: British Horse Society Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
WORDFROMHOME topped April's Goffs Aintree Sale on the back of his success in an Irish Point and may well make a winning start under Rules. Newcomers Manu du Noyer and Block Flight also appeal on paper for top yards.

  1. WORDFROMHOME (IRE)
  2. MANU DU NOYER (FR)
  3. BLOCK FLIGHT (FR)

races.name: BetVictor Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
No form to go on but lots of potential in this closing bumper and the market should reveal plenty. Dan Skelton's Doyen gelding NEWGROVE was an impressive winner on his only run in an Irish point in the spring and gets the nod over Geissler who hails from a yard with a good record in this event. Treble Three and Radiant Walk are also in excellent hands and need factoring in, too.

  1. NEWGROVE (IRE)
  2. GEISSLER (IRE)
  3. TREBLE THREE (IRE)

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back Handicap
races.verdict:
MACANUDO has a far more solid profile than most of these and a reproduction of recent efforts looks sure to see him go well. Little Jaybee is another with recent winning form to her name so she's a threat, as too is Ten Cuidado if in the same form as 10 days ago.

  1. MACANUDO (IRE)
  2. LITTLE JAYBEE
  3. TEN CUIDADO (IRE)

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
NOLTON CROSS is fancied to make a big impact returning to a C&D where he's won twice before and with a handy mark to work with, he can prove too strong for John T, who ran well when second here 26 days ago and is building a good all-weather profile. Oneforthegutter is well treated and will be staying on strongly if they go hard enough for him.

  1. NOLTON CROSS (IRE)
  2. JOHN T
  3. ONEFORTHEGUTTER

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Handicap
races.verdict:
BENACRE is well handicapped on last winter's form and could prove a different proposition with visor applied and freshened up by a break. He therefore looks worth chancing. Lillie Margot has a solid-looking profile and shouldn't be far away, while Orangesandlemons won over C&D in the past and may do better down in grade.

  1. BENACRE (IRE)
  2. LILLIE MARGOT
  3. ORANGESANDLEMONS

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FENAROLI shaped with plenty of promise when third behind a couple boasting prior experience at Kempton 4 weeks ago, coming from much further back than that pair in the process. Very well bred and looking sure to improve, this looks a good opening for Harry Charlton's colt. Bombora is very much a work in progress but Karl Burke's colt may well still emerge as the chief threat.

  1. FENAROLI
  2. BOMBORA
  3. KNIGHTBOLT (IRE)

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
RIBENSKA's best efforts have come on all-weather and with this return to 7f sure to be in her favour, Charlie Fellowes' 4-y-o gets the tentative nod to double her tally from a sliding mark at the expense of Enola Grey, who looked unlucky not to finish closer at Wolverhampton recently. Course winner Spirit of Jenny rounds off the shortlist.

  1. RIBENSKA (IRE)
  2. ENOLA GREY (IRE)
  3. SPIRIT OF JENNY (IRE)

races.name: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Nursery
races.verdict:
An open-looking sprint in which it could pay to side with NORTH STAR KODI, who boasts some strong maiden form at Hamilton back in the spring and the handicapper has given him a chance having failed to fire in a couple of nurseries thus far. Pride's Queen took a step forward switched to a nursery last time, so she heads up the dangers, with Commander Keith and Angelic Melody taken to fight out third.

  1. NORTH STAR KODI (IRE)
  2. PRIDE'S QUEEN
  3. COMMANDER KEITH (IRE)

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CELESTIAL FIRE showed plenty to work on amidst greenness when third at Redcar back in the spring and with improvement likely now stepped up in trip, Archie Watson's filly earns the vote over Hoya Bella, who is bred for longer trips but has shaped promisingly in both starts to date. Classic Bellini can edge out Wadima for minor honours.

  1. CELESTIAL FIRE (IRE)
  2. HOYA BELLA
  3. CLASSIC BELLINI

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Harry Charlton 3-y-o THAT'S RANDOM might be worth siding with to resume his progression with his recent Leicester outing behind him. Modern Times was a bit better than the result when fifth at Kempton last month and is feared most back at the scene of his success in July. Fair Y Isle has a progressive profile on all-weather and could also play a part if fully primed after a break.

  1. THAT'S RANDOM
  2. MODERN TIMES
  3. FAIR Y ISLE

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
In a finale where the majority arrive with a point to prove the vote goes to PRINCE OF PILLO after his back-to-form second here last time. Infinity Blue's infrequent visits to the track this year suggests there's been the odd issue but he shaped quite well on his reappearance at the end of the summer and is second choice ahead of Maldevious.

  1. PRINCE OF PILLO (IRE)
  2. INFINITY BLUE (IRE)
  3. MALDEVIOUS (IRE)

races.name: Midnite Built Different Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
LABICHE made a promising start to life with James Owen when fourth at Wolverhampton on Monday and turned out quickly, could be the answer. Jenson Benson and Far Far Out are in-form rivals, while Saahir could be a different proposition returned to all-weather.

  1. LABICHE
  2. JENSON BENSON (IRE)
  3. FAR FAR OUT (IRE)

races.name: Midnite Built Different Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
EIGHTY EIGHT shaped encouragingly starting out for his shrewd connections when second at Wolverhampton recently and holds obvious claims off the same mark. Recent wide-margin winner Power of Prayer looks the clear threat under a penalty, while Taskheer has made a decent start for this yard.

  1. EIGHTY EIGHT (IRE)
  2. POWER OF PRAYER (GER)
  3. TASKHEER (IRE)

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back Nursery
races.verdict:
CHAISE LONGUE emerged with a lot of credit when beating a next-time-out winner at Yarmouth a month ago and with this step up in distance expected to suit, she has plenty to recommend her. Wild Orchid and Queens Bandit are feared most, though Turtle Star is a potential improver.

  1. CHAISE LONGUE
  2. WILD ORCHID
  3. QUEENS BANDIT

races.name: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
MR FREEDOM looks ready to strike off his reduced mark given how he shaped at Goodwood last time. Pyleates is next best having had excuses at Salisbury.

  1. MR FREEDOM
  2. PYLEATES
  3. MUST BELIEVE

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap
races.verdict:
BAJAN BANDIT's recent victories have come at a lower level than this, yet he was a ready winner on the latest of them at Wolverhampton 9 days ago and, escaping a penalty, he may well take some stepping from a good draw in this form. Havana Touch has done well on all-weather this year and he commands plenty of respect too, with Nakaaha and The Hare Rail completing the shortlist.

  1. BAJAN BANDIT
  2. HAVANA TOUCH
  3. NAKAAHA

races.name: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GALIMIX was a long way clear of the rest when second at Bath 4 weeks ago and the 3 lb he receives from penalised debut winner Tough Decision tips the scales his way. Bizzo Flavin also needs considering after a promising opening effort.

  1. GALIMIX (IRE)
  2. TOUGH DECISION
  3. BIZZO FLAVIN

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
races.verdict:
MARHABA YA TAYIB can prove to be a bargain buy for new connections with the form of his Kempton win looking better now than it did at the time. Maliqui and Star Bayside Boy were big eye-catchers last time so rate the main threats.

  1. MARHABA YA TAYIB (IRE)
  2. MALIQUI (IRE)
  3. STAR BAYSIDE BOY (IRE)

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MISSMISFORTUNE was a big eye-catcher at Wolverhampton last time so is preferred to the more exposed Baandee.

  1. MISSMISFORTUNE (IRE)
  2. BAANDEE
  3. TWO STEPS TWICE

races.name: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap
races.verdict:
FUSEBOARD looked transformed this summer and is taken to pick up where he left off and complete the hat-trick. Fellow 3-y-os Preferred and Far Too Fizzy are feared most.

  1. FUSEBOARD
  2. PREFERRED
  3. FAR TOO FIZZY
